components.name: Primary Workflow Button
components.description: The single full-width action that advances an event workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 2.8rem; padding: .7rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, .75rem); color: #fff; background: var(--color-accent-strong, #075bd8); box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgb(7 91 216 / 18%); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 680; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #075bd8); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(7 91 216 / 22%); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .62; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Healthy Status Pill
components.description: A word-and-dot state marker for healthy, active, or resolved conditions.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; width: fit-content; min-height: 1.75rem; padding: .25rem .65rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-dot { width: .42rem; height: .42rem; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status-healthy { color: var(--color-status-healthy-text, #12604d); background: var(--color-status-healthy-bg, #e4f3ed); }

components.name: Critical Status Pill
components.description: The same stable pill geometry used for critical, high-priority, and overdue states.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; width: fit-content; min-height: 1.75rem; padding: .25rem .65rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-dot { width: .42rem; height: .42rem; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status-critical { color: var(--color-status-critical-text, #9f2d25); background: var(--color-status-critical-bg, #ffebe8); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The selected destination in the stable clinic index.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; min-height: 2.65rem; align-items: center; gap: .72rem; padding: .45rem .65rem; border-radius: .7rem; color: var(--color-accent-strong, #075bd8); background: var(--color-accent-soft, #edf4ff); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: .86rem; font-weight: 580; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #075bd8); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(7 91 216 / 22%); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A plain bordered field for staff-supplied event resolution context.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">What actually happened?<input class="ds-text-field" type="text" placeholder="Example: Assisted movement"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: .5rem; color: var(--color-text, #1d1d1f); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-text-field { width: 100%; padding: .7rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #dedee3); border-radius: var(--radius-control, .75rem); color: var(--color-text, #1d1d1f); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); font: inherit; font-weight: 400; } .ds-text-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #075bd8); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(7 91 216 / 22%); }

components.name: Working Sheet
components.description: The primary white folio surface for evidence, interpretation, actions, and facts.
components.html:
What the sensors observed

Structured evidence appears here in plain language.
components.css: .ds-work-sheet { padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #dedee3); border-radius: var(--radius-card, 1rem); color: var(--color-text, #1d1d1f); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 4%), 0 10px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-work-sheet h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-work-sheet p { margin: .35rem 0 0; color: var(--color-text-muted, #636366); font-size: .84rem; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Selected Outcome Card
components.description: A compact radio-card for the event resolution outcome.
components.css: .ds-outcome-selected { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: .6rem; padding: .7rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #075bd8); border-radius: var(--radius-control, .75rem); color: var(--color-text, #1d1d1f); background: var(--color-accent-soft, #edf4ff); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: .8rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-outcome-selected input { margin-top: .15rem; accent-color: var(--color-accent-strong, #075bd8); } .ds-outcome-selected strong, .ds-outcome-selected small { display: block; } .ds-outcome-selected small { margin-top: .2rem; color: var(--color-text-muted, #636366); font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 450; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-outcome-selected:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(7 91 216 / 22%); }

narrative.overview:
Adaptive Care behaves like a well-kept care-plan folio: a stable index, one clear working sheet, and deeper evidence immediately behind the item in focus. The interface is calm but not passive. Warm paper and quiet white surfaces lower visual noise so attention, uncertainty, and the next staff action remain unmistakable.

The system is compact enough for an operational console but leaves deliberate room around consequential information. Native-feeling controls, restrained motion, and progressive detail make the product feel precise without implying medical certainty.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas with crisp white working sheets.
Cobalt reserved for selection, navigation, focus, and staff action.
Semantic states pair words and dots with color; color never carries meaning alone.
Compact fixed-column scanning on wide screens, stacked records on narrow screens.
Soft folio layering through hairline borders, gentle shadows, and occasional sheet edges.

rules.name: The One Action Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means navigation, selection, focus, or an available staff action; it does not decorate neutral information.

rules.name: The Meaning Needs Words Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color is accompanied by a direct text label and, where useful, a dot or boundary.

rules.name: The Quiet Normal Rule
rules.body: Normal and healthy rooms remain visually calm; amber and red appear only when the underlying state earns attention.

rules.name: The Title Budget Rule
rules.body: Large type identifies the page or event; operational rows and panels rely on compact titles instead of competing headlines.

rules.name: The Plain Evidence Rule
rules.body: Sensor evidence, limitations, and staff actions use sentence case and readable line spacing rather than display styling.

rules.name: The Attention-Then-Inventory Rule
rules.body: A screen presents urgent work before the full resident or event inventory, then preserves a direct path into evidence and action.

rules.name: The Collapse by Importance Rule
rules.body: Narrow layouts remove secondary columns before they compress primary labels, statuses, or the next staff action.

rules.name: The Folio Layer Rule
rules.body: Depth clarifies persistent chrome, a working sheet, or an active control; it never exists as ornamental floating-card scenery.

rules.name: The Motion Explains State Rule
rules.body: Short 150–160ms transitions support hover and selection; longer 360–520ms animations are reserved for acknowledged, checked, and resolved workflow changes and are removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Soft Geometry Rule
rules.body: Operational containers stay rectangular and aligned; rounded corners soften the console without turning it into a collection of bubbles.

dos: Do lead with the next caregiver decision, then reveal evidence, quality, device context, and history progressively.
Do keep synthetic-data labeling visible in persistent chrome.
Do pair every semantic color with words and preserve unavailable or limited states as explicit states.
Do use the shared 0.75rem control radius, 1rem card radius, hairline borders, and ambient shadow for new operational surfaces.
Do preserve keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior in every new control or transition.
donts: Don't use cobalt, amber, red, or green as decoration; each color has an operational job.
Don't replace uncertainty with precise-looking numbers, diagnoses, or reassuring empty space.
Don't create equal-weight card mosaics that hide the attention-to-action path.
Don't shrink primary labels or staff actions to preserve secondary table columns on narrow screens.
Don't add heavy gradients, dark command-center styling, decorative motion, or extra floating layers to this quiet folio world.
